title: Operation "Zero Zeno": Israel-linked influence activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreprorted Israel-origin operation we dubbed “Zero Zeno,” using AI to generate anti-Hamas, anti-Qatar, pro-Israel, anti-BJP, and pro-Histadrut content.
